title: demo.mobile_otp@v1 response (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: `otp_sent` after step 1 (the response also carries the X-Hub-Session header), `verified` after a correct OTP on step 2. A wrong or expired OTP is a 422 UPSTREAM_REJECTED error, not a response. Callers must ignore unknown fields.

expires_in_s.description: Seconds until the OTP expires (step 1 only).

vendor_ref.description: Opaque upstream reference for support correlation. Never parse it.
